title: dev-target.json
description: Non-secret connection config for the dev environment, read by the aidp http/mongo/sqs runners and `aidp dev`. Lives at `.aidp/dev-target.json` (git-ignore it in the target repo). Secrets are NOT stored here — they come from AIDP_DEV_* env vars at request time.

base_url.description: Prepended to relative URLs (those starting with '/').

token_env.description: Env var holding a bearer token, added as `Authorization: Bearer <value>`.

health_path.description: Path appended to base_url by `aidp dev check --ping`.

uri_env.description: Env var holding the full connection URI with credentials (default AIDP_DEV_MONGO_URI).

profile.description: AWS CLI profile used for credentials/SSO.

queues.description: Logical queue name -> full queue URL.

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow file to dispatch, e.g. deploy-dev.yml.

repo.description: owner/repo for gh, if not the current directory's repo.
